Pins

Actual readings and gate stability
All51 assigned windows returned completely in51 distinct terminal executions, each exit0:34 whole-unit windows and17 exact-line windows. No sampling, borrowed reading credit, unreadable units, truncation, missing intervals or reading failures. Opening gate, ranges and closing gate were separate mechanics. Closing gate followed all readings; both gates exited0 and their complete payloads match, including scope SHA and CURRENT RU rubric identities. Working RAW/Git RAW/LF were not confused with frozen EN same-path hashes.
Read31 whole teaching bodies:four primary EN/RU pairs, ten CURRENT context EN/RU pairs, three whole EN-only comparisons =17 EN/14 RU. Changed 喜び/喜ぶ/声 word bodies were CURRENT, not baseline substitutes.
Read99 whole official TEXT units:15 KANJIDIC records, two Unicode radical rows,78 ordered entity-expanded whole JMdict objects, four whole visible KanjiPedia entries with actual ALT labels. One whole provider header is additional:database2026-308, creation2026-11-04. No whole rawHTML/audio/pixel claim.
Read327 complete CURRENT typed metadata rows, all12 directed proposals, four L, four A, three exact NAV diffs and four LIMITS. Completed guidance line unions395/264/216/108 and rubric unions44/55/45:four whole CURRENT RU guidance files and three whole localized contracts. This is not327 whole lessons or1478 fresh word-guard judgments. Four new strokes are gate-verified RAW-identical to frozen source, not geometry/native-approved.
Delivery mechanics:two pre-print size assertions failed, at12197 and11307 UTF8 bytes, each exit1; neither emitted a report body. These are delivery-size failures, not reading failures. The final text is separately sized before emission.

Separate facet verdicts
C1 — SUPPORT for new/changed source teaching within assigned evidence. Selected meanings/readings, grammar and examples are supported; no necessary Japanese correction established. Preserve frozen IDs, reading inventories, tags and community JLPT; provider old-JLPT values do not override the community classification. Mnemonics remain explicitly nonhistorical.
C2 — qualified SUPPORT for bounded source authoring/dependencies and introductory comparisons, NOT unrestricted quiz-negative approval. All directed endpoints have current typed identities and whole assigned contexts; required word links reach 喜/声. Optional EN-only material supplies no RU provider. N012 remains unresolved for negative use. Full-tree validation, renderer/fallback behavior and ordinary quiz suitability were not executed or established.
C3 — SUPPORT for the14 whole CURRENT RU bodies:understandable without English, with translations preserving roles, polarity and relevant Japanese distinctions. No consequential Russian defect requiring correction found; no native-speaker or measured learning-effectiveness claim.
Necessary fixes:none established in assigned teaching prose/frozen metadata. Preserve the consequential C2 qualifications rather than relabeling them CLEAN or active-negative clearance.

Individual lesson decisions
L001 否 — S. Seven strokes/口30 and ヒ/いな/いや match KANJIDIC; denial/可否 are supported. 不-over-口 is a mnemonic. Extra KanjiPedia フ/わるい is not an automatic frozen-inventory error.
L002 告 — S. Seven strokes/口30, コク/つ.げる and 報告/広告 agree with sources. Informing includes signalling; 牛-like upper strokes imply neither cattle meaning nor historical proof.
L003 喜 — S. Twelve strokes/口30 and frozen readings supported. Joy need not involve laughter/voice. Two boxes are a memory aid; rare whole-word variants do not invent kanji readings.
L004 声 — SQ for introductory coverage; C1 supported. Modern声7/士33 differs from old聲17/耳128. All four readings have bounded examples; utterance/sound/phonetic extensions prevent a voice-only guard.

Dictionary clarification decisions
A001 否 — S. Whole2857381 marksいな formal/literary;2857380 hasいや NO, usually kana;1482860 separately supportsひ disagreement, voting no/noes and negative prefix/suffix. 嫌いや1587610 is separate:its unpleasantness senses do not transfer automatically.
A002 告 — S. Whole1285990 is ichidan/transitive:inform/announce AND indicate/signal/mark. 報告1515670 is not document-only; whole EN context permits spoken/written reporting. 広告1278510 supports advertising/announcement. The dot inつ.げる marks okurigana, not a pause or substitution ofコク.
A003 喜 — S. Whole1218760 is godan-bu, transitive/intransitive; 喜んで/喜びます agree with whole lessons. 喜ばす1612230 is godan-su/transitive, pleasing someone, not the dictionary form喜ぶ. 喜び1606140 includes joy/congratulations; formal use and rare whole-word spellings remain bounded.
A004 声 — S. 声色1380500こわいろ tone/mimicry differs from1800610せいしょく. 声明1380540せいめい is declaration;2187150しょうみょう includes ancient Indian linguistic studies AND Buddhist chanting; RU explicitly selects chanting. 声2843115しょう is specialized Buddhist/prosodic, not ordinaryこえ replacement. 大声1414300 supportsおおごえ, not universal voicing or exclusion ofたいせい.

Individual directed negatives
S=support; SQ=qualified support for an introductory core comparison only; U=UNVERIFIED. Each direction was assessed separately from whole endpoints and sources, not titles alone, reversal or transitivity. ALL N001–N012 ordinary active-negative safety remains U; no unrestricted all-sense disjointness established.
N001 否→古 — SQ. Refusal/disagreement2857380/2857381/1482860 contrasts with antiquity1265040 and used-item/prefix1265060; bounded core meanings only.
N002 否→告 — SQ. Denial1482990 differs from informing1285990 as an introductory focus; a denial can itself be announced.
N003 否→味 — SQ. Negative response differs from taste/charm/experience1526960 and taste/counter2258680. Separate嫌 is not evidence that否 means unpleasant taste.
N004 告→古 — SQ. Telling/signalling1285990 differs from ancient/used1265040/1265060; shape/headlines alone prove no semantic disjointness.
N005 告→否 — SQ. Informing1285990 versus negative judgment1482990, independently assessed in this direction; an announcement may contain a refusal.
N006 告→牛 — SQ. Informing differs from cattle/beef/constellation1231490; rare phonetic牛2085820 supplies no informing sense. Shared upper strokes are not lexical equivalence.
N007 喜→声 — SQ. Positive reaction/congratulating/welcoming1218760 differs from voice/opinion1380440; joy can be silent, and voiced joy does not make these unrestricted opposites.
N008 喜→古 — SQ. Rejoicing/joy1218760/1606140 versus antiquity/used-item1265040/1265060, not merely different titles or stroke counts.
N009 喜→告 — SQ. Joy1218760/1606140 versus conveying information1285990; announcing happy news can instantiate both activities.
N010 声→売 — SQ. Whole声1380440/KanjiPedia cover voice/utterance/sound; whole売 lessons and KANJIDIC support selling. Shared7 strokes/士33 is not semantic proof; no whole JMdict売 occurs in the assigned78.
N011 声→古 — SQ. Voice/opinion/sound and specialized prosody1380440/2843115 contrast at core level with antiquity/used items1265040/1265060; not every reading mode is certified.
N012 声→告 — U; negative clearance withheld. KanjiPedia声②言う/述べる intersects 告①つげる/知らせる/語る. Whole声1380440 expressed opinion, 声明1380540 declaration and 告げる1285990 informing corroborate the utterance domain. Title «голос» and RU disclosure do not eliminate this Japanese overlap.

Navigation decisions
NAV1 喜び — S:only existing explanatory喜 gains its kanji-link wrapper; prose/metadata unchanged.
NAV2 喜ぶ — S:same single-glyph wrapper change; Japanese, old links and quiz_exclusions[喜び,幸せ,幸福] unchanged. Exclusions retain only original support/identity, not fresh word-guard approval.
NAV3 声 — S:only explanatory声 gains its kanji link; readingこえ, 大声 explanation and other text/metadata unchanged. No translation or semantic rewrite authorized by these diffs.

Outside-edge LIMITS, not fresh global pair judgments
O001 否 — LIMIT. Typed不/反/悪 andひ in日/火 flag negation/opposition/badness/homophony; whole KanjiPedia否③わるい shows the headline is not exhaustive. No new guard follows.
O002 告 — LIMIT. Typed伝/言/話/語/申/知 andコク in刻/国/黒 flag transmission/speaking/knowledge and homophony. EN-only報 is a comparison, not a CURRENT327 RU provider.
O003 喜 — LIMIT. Typed楽/気/危/帰/木/福/心/思 flag pleasure/emotion andキ domains, not approved pairs. Accepted WORD笑う does not supply KANJI笑; neither笑 nor報 is in CURRENT327.
O004 声 — LIMIT. Whole声1380440/2843115 and音1576900/2859161/2859162 overlap in sound/phonetics. Typed言/話/語/聞/耳/歌 and世/正/生/青 mark limits, not whole-sense judgments or an all-pool matrix.

Preserved limitations and authority
The21 citation ID/form/reading slots matching21 distinct IDs mechanically is not21 independent semantic reviews. Exact-form search misses告/喜/喜ばせる/売 prove neither absence nor register/frequency. Broad modern quiz necessity/frequency, fallback safety and global current/future uniqueness remain U. Metadata retention is not guard approval. No new guard, direction removal, metadata correction, reverse or transitive/clique pair proposed.
Historical limits remain:094呼/吹 overlap U and all9 ordinary U;093 all27 ordinary U;091割→利 U;082姉→妹 U. Protected033 WORD空 remains excluded/C2U/runtime-absent, not media; accepted KANJI空 does not resolve it. Prior-batch mechanical/delivery failures are not imported into095.
One reviewer; no delegation/contact, writes, tests/builds, Git mutation or network/auth changes. No pixel/native/audio, app/device/phone/IME, media/default/package/release or full8278 completion approval. Checkpoint authority remains null/Ready false; C6/C7 do not block independently reviewed source authoring. This report alone neither accepts the candidate nor translates or approves further material.
